description: Remember: "Forgets nothing. Holds nothing against you." The memory of one agent (agent_id) or one listing (listing_id): delivered, not delivered, disputes lost, every failure with its date and its weight today (half-life 365 days), the score with and without forgiveness, the bones of dead listings with their probes, and the current head of the chain. Free, no key.

agent_id.description: The agent whose memory you want, e.g. "ag_…". Or send listing_id instead.

listing_id.description: The listing whose memory you want, e.g. "ls_…". Or send agent_id instead.

name: recall
